lesson: 在分布式聚合下推中构造“不命中任何分区”的谓词（IN ()、= NULL），断言 COUNT 返回 0 而不是协调端因收到 0 个分片结果而报错。
evidence: nyh: "p IN ()"... has no partitions at all, so gets sent to no node, and I guess that confuses the code

lesson: 对自研 future/回调轮询器注入“poll 期间立即被唤醒”的时序，断言不发生锁重入死锁，并监控心跳线程是否持续上报。
evidence: https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/11550 "very easy to get deadlock if the future is woken immediately during polling"

lesson: 对 CDC 每种 delta/preimage 模式逐一断言元数据列（operation、ttl）始终保留，避免裁剪逻辑误删。
evidence: haaawk: "I think we need them actually" (cdc$* columns removed by postprocessing)

lesson: 在成员变更提案被评估后、提交前转移 lease 并让新 leader 提交另一个 conf change，断言旧提案被明确失败（含 ambiguous）而非永久占着 latch。
evidence: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/106104 "raft silently replaces the conf change with an empty entry"

lesson: 对已有数据的表执行 ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT x NOT NULL，与拆成两步的结果对比，断言要么回填默认值要么一致报错。
evidence: tedyu: 'default 1 not null' path hits missingMode / "Operation not allowed in YugaByte mode heap_insert"

lesson: 在开启虚拟 intent 解析后让事务过期且禁用异步清理，再跑 SKIP LOCKED 扫描，断言不会被物理残留 intent 阻塞。
evidence: miraradeva: "with VIR, non-locking reads don't resolve intents physically anymore"; closed as dup of #167582

lesson: 在 RPC 流协商与首条带 stream id 的消息之间注入服务端延迟，断言消息不会先于注册到达而让客户端永久挂起。
evidence: xemul: "It's a race in stream registration and actual data sent into it"

lesson: 在两条存活行之间写入百万级行/分区墓碑后分页扫描，断言每页耗时有界且能返回空页+有效续传键。
evidence: https://github.com/scylladb/scylladb/pull/11053 "Tombstones don't count towards the query's page limit"

lesson: DDL 回填中触发多条同错误码警告，断言 SHOW WARNINGS 的消息与计数和逐行值一致。
evidence: mjonss: "we store the warnings in a map with only the ErrorID"

lesson: 在导出/导入 schema 的回放工具中使用含分号、引号的注释，断言 dump→load 往返成功。
evidence: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/65885 "Use the SQL parser to split schema files so semicolons in comments are handled"

lesson: 对 GROUP BY + 聚合在零匹配输入下与参考实现（Cassandra）做差分测试，断言返回空结果集而非 null 行。
evidence: Scylla returns one result row: p=null, c=null, count(c)=0

lesson: 执行不带 sink 的 changefeed 后立即做相关 schema 变更，断言变更不需等待 lease 过期（5 分钟）。
evidence: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/78142 "Release descriptor leases acquired during core style changefeed planning"
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/131787 "query would aggregate every tenant's timeseries data" (test bug)

lesson: 用小键空间随机变更生成器并发跑扫描读与缓存驱逐，断言读到的行集合与无缓存基准一致，且缓存连续性标记不吞行。
evidence: https://github.com/scylladb/scylladb/pull/11240 "no_clustering_row_between(a, b)... by definition excludes the starting key"

lesson: 用很小的 chunk 让 bulk ingest 同时产生大量 SST，使 L0 触发写阻塞，断言 ingest、flush、compaction 三者不会互相等待死锁。
evidence: tbg: ingestion blocked on flushing memtable... "compaction thread... stuck waiting for IngestExternalFile"

lesson: 对表达式索引的定义做 MySQL 兼容性差分，断言行值、子查询等非法表达式在 CREATE TABLE 与 CREATE INDEX 两条路径上一致被拒。
evidence: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/18125 "build hidden columns' info" when creating table with expression index

lesson: 对含多个 keyspace/表的 vschema 反复初始化，断言在全部 keyspace 加载完成前不会以“table not found”处理查询。
evidence: https://github.com/vitessio/vitess/pull/10396 "was not checking if the keyspaces in the vschema were loaded correctly"

lesson: 在追加加密元数据日志时注入磁盘满/写中断，重启后断言能截断不完整尾记录并正常启动。
evidence: yiwu-arbug: "a partial record is written to the end of file dictionary file when disk is full"

lesson: 滚动重启中让 PD 连发多个 transfer-leader，在旧请求未完成时选出新 leader，断言 follower 清除旧的预热状态、不会在预热完成前当选。
evidence: https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/19922 "prevents an expired request from the previous leader from being acknowledged"

lesson: 人为打满 raft peer 通道，断言对应的 channel-full 指标递增（监控回归测试）。
evidence: rleungx: "This metrics has been removed by https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/4232"

lesson: 用包含引号、括号等 JSON 特殊字符的分区键触发 toppartitions，断言输出是合法 JSON。
evidence: jul-stas: "C-S was lucky to generate a key which closes the json mid-way"; "we just need to escape the json contents"

lesson: 在旧版本创建带表达式分区边界（TO_SECONDS('...')）的表，升级到新版本后断言 schema 加载成功。
evidence: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/17971 "old version TiDB, partition definition store the less than XXX as raw expression"

lesson: 建带过滤条件（基表普通列成为视图键）的物化视图，ALTER 基表（哪怕只改注释）后写一行，断言视图更新不崩溃且结果正确。
evidence: psarna: cached "select_statement" from view_info... not invalidated when new definition of the base" arrives
kostja: "I don't think anything needs to be done for this issue."; warning = schema commitlog shares dir

lesson: 对周期性状态 RPC 连续调用数小时，断言进程环境变量/内存不随调用次数增长。
evidence: https://github.com/vitessio/vitess/pull/15096 "blindly prepending /usr/sbin: to the PATH... every time it was called"
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/136930 "disable rate limiters in mixedversion" (test config)

lesson: 在混合版本集群中写入带 TTL 的更新，断言新旧节点都能反序列化对方的 mutation、hint 与 commitlog。
evidence: tgrabiec: "changed the representation of gc_clock::duration from 32-bit to 64-bit. The IDL references it directly"

lesson: 在高 shard 数下于写入进行中关闭节点，断言所有异步写路径在使用前持有 gate，关闭时无“gate closed”断言。
evidence: bhalevy: "database::apply_in_memory calls run_when_memory_available without holding the gate"

lesson: flashback 到时间点 A 后再推进 GC safepoint 并触发 compaction，断言旧版本数据不丢、不出现 DefaultNotFound。
evidence: https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/13450 "deleting the old MVCC keys directly will cause the GC Compaction Filter to mishandle"

lesson: 让 range 短暂失去 lease/quorum（短于选举+lease 间隔），断言进行中的写不会被熔断器过早取消成 ambiguous result。
evidence: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/121074 "cancelled write requests can't be automatically retried"
